content: bcrypt (native, v6.0.0) vs bcryptjs (pure-JS, v3.0.3) for password hashing. bcryptjs has zero native build step, works in any environment incl. Alpine musl Docker images without node-gyp/prebuilt-binary risk; bcrypt is faster but requires a compiled addon whose Alpine/musl prebuilt-binary coverage is best-effort only. 2026 common cost-factor default is 12 (~250-500ms/hash on modern hardware); drop to 10-11 for constrained environments.
